swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): In India 'Mir Jafar' is still used as a synonym for 'traitor'. Reason (R): Mir Jafar was promised the throne of Bengal and kept his forces out of the fighting at Plassey, handing the Company its victory. Choose the correct option.
